Cash-basis budget schedules (pp15-19) vs statement columns: Street 1,976,081 vs 1,808,308 (+167,773); CDBG 296,028 vs 298,335 (-2,307); Debt Service 1,245,768 vs 1,241,346 (+4,422); LB 357 1,679,493 vs 1,619,268 (+60,225); Capital Projects capital outlay 3,416,941 vs 3,928,032 (-511,091). Sum -280,978 = the whole gap. No fix.

Statement fund columns (trimmed pp6-7) 'Transfer from (to) other funds': General (3,489,878), Street 1,160,718, Debt Service 1,167,216, LB 357 (269,760), Capital Projects (164,828), Other Funds 1,290,854; transfers in 3,618,788. The General Fund departmental combining statement (pp22-23) prints the General Fund's transfers per department, gross: General department (11,954,581), and in to Capital Projects 140,534, Auditorium 149,401, Parks 662,845, Police 2,898,631, Community Center 618,584, Aquatic Center 265,781, Ball Park 280,377, Senior Center 19,342, Convention Center 412,880, Fire/EMS 1,917,955, Library 714,950, Museum 78,369, Police & Fire Pension 305,054 = 8,464,703. These are transfers between departments inside the General Fund (net -11,954,581 + 8,464,703 = -3,489,878 = statement General column). 3,618,788 + 8,464,703 = 12,083,491 = schedule total. Same money grossed within one fund. No fix.

Statement transfers out 3,924,466 = General 3,489,878 + LB 357 269,760 + Capital Projects 164,828 (trimmed pp6-7). In detail the General Fund out is the General department's gross (11,954,581) on the departmental combining statement (p22), which includes the 8,464,703 sent to the other General Fund departments (see transfers_in). 3,924,466 + 8,464,703 = 12,389,169 = schedule total. No fix.
